title.zh: 自然意志发布Natura-1：学了100万小时人类动作，机器人能做没练过的活
title.en: 自然意志发布Natura-1：学了100万小时人类动作，机器人能做没练过的活

current_state.zh: Chinese embodied-AI company 自然意志 released Natura-1, a 50B-parameter MoE model pretrained on 1 million hours of first-person human video that adapts to a 20-DoF dexterous hand and executes unseen tasks without task-specific training, at under 100ms latency.
current_state.en: Chinese embodied-AI company 自然意志 released Natura-1, a 50B-parameter MoE model pretrained on 1 million hours of first-person human video that adapts to a 20-DoF dexterous hand and executes unseen tasks without task-specific training, at under 100ms latency.
